# Mohamed Ben Achour

> A personal knowledge hub exploring the intersection of software engineering, AI, DevOps, and transdisciplinary thinking.

Mohamed Ben Achour's website showcases expertise in modern software architecture, cloud infrastructure, and AI-driven development. The site reflects a philosophy combining technical depth with broader systems thinking influenced by thinkers like Edgar Morin.
